title: 節點計量器重啟、計數器重置、Outbox 佇列上限與安全停轉發 (Node Sampler Restart, Counter Reset, Outbox Caps & Safety Fail-Closed)
expected: Node sampler persists checkpoints and monotonic event_seq across agent restart, emits a counter_reset gap without negative deltas when kernel counters drop or table inet fvpn is recreated, and stops member forwarding (keeping control plane up) when outbox age/size or disk floor is breached.
actual: Live node container fvpn-w4-usage-node initialized /var/lib/vpn-node/state/usage.db & agent.db (/var/lib/vpn-node/state/usage.db size=4096 mode=600; /var/lib/vpn-node/state/agent.db size=69632 mode=600) and loaded /etc/vpn-node/trust.json, while mTLS GET /api/v1/agent/desired-state returned HTTP 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE and PUT /api/v1/admin/nodes/01a18a49-4020-71c6-ad22-893acd249a8b/publication returned HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE, keeping periodic live sampling fail-closed. Node meter, usagestore, usageupload, and agent.Decide tests verified restart continuity, counter_reset gap emission, outbox caps, and fail-closed forwarding withdrawal.
blockers: Live node periodic sampling requires admitted member forwarding, which is blocked on main by PUT /api/v1/admin/nodes/01a18a49-4020-71c6-ad22-893acd249a8b/publication returning HTTP 422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE ({"error":{"code":"NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE","message":"node does not satisfy serving baseline requirements","request_id":"01a18a56-1b83-7802-8c0f-98bbc9d92e63","retryable":false,"details":{"failed_checks":["provisioning_state=applying (want ready)"]}}}) and GET /api/v1/agent/desired-state returning HTTP 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.

mechanism_checks.name: LiveNodeTrustBundleAndUsageSQLiteStore
mechanism_checks.summary: Enrolled node fvpn-w4-usage-node loaded /etc/vpn-node/trust.json, initialized SQLite WAL stores (/var/lib/vpn-node/state/usage.db size=4096 mode=600; /var/lib/vpn-node/state/agent.db size=69632 mode=600), and mTLS GET /api/v1/agent/desired-state responded HTTP 503 (DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE).

mechanism_checks.name: ControlledRestartWithFinalSampleAndCrashPoints
mechanism_checks.summary: node/internal/meter and node/internal/usagestore prove Barrier + FinalSample clean epoch handoff and crash injection across sample.read, sample.plan, before_commit, and after_commit with zero double counting or byte loss.

mechanism_checks.name: CounterResetAndExternalRulesetResetDetection
mechanism_checks.summary: enforce.DetectResets and enforce.DetectMeterResets detect both counter value decreases (2200 -> 100 B) and external chain/generation flushes, rotating meter_epoch_id while keeping event_seq monotonic.

mechanism_checks.name: FailClosedGateAndOutboxHysteresisRecovery
mechanism_checks.summary: agent.Decide blocks member forwarding with METER_PATH_INVALID, METER_STORAGE_FAILED, OUTBOX_FULL, and DISK_LOW while keeping control up; usagestore.EvaluateGate enforces sticky 80% hysteresis before resuming forwarding.

mechanism_checks.name: UPD03StatePreservedAcrossNodeUpdate
mechanism_checks.summary: Persistent SQLite state/usage.db preserves node_incarnation_id, acked_through, next_seq, and unACKed outbox events across node binary switches.
